name: check_quality
description: Retrieve quality inspection records for a specific product or batch, including the inspection result, defect count and inspector. Requires either a product identifier or a batch identifier.

product_id.description: The product identifier to inspect, for example 'PROD-001'.

batch_id.description: The batch identifier to inspect, for example 'BATCH-2201'.

name: get_compliance
description: Return the compliance status of a supplier, product or facility, including certifications held and the next audit date.

entity_id.description: The identifier of the entity to check, for example 'SUP-001' or 'PROD-003'.

entity_type.description: The kind of entity being checked.

name: get_standards
description: Retrieve the quality standards that apply to a product category, including tolerance thresholds and the governing specification.

product_category.description: The product category, for example 'Electrical', 'Fasteners' or 'Hydraulics'.
